publication.title: Expressive and scalable query-based faceted search over SPARQL endpoints

source_reading.scope: Abstract/UI framing, endpoint suggestion computation, complete evaluation and limitations (§§5–7).

adjudication.basis: Sparklis implements endpoint-based query/focus faceted exploration with English verbalization and suggestions. The source separates portability tests, expert-guided benchmark timings and preliminary usability cohorts; these must remain separate denominators.
